scheme_name: Stipends To Trainees In Industrial Training Institute
other_conditions: Must be a permanent resident of Maharashtra.
Must belong to the Scheduled Caste (SC) category.
Must be enrolled in a recognized Industrial Training Institute (ITI).
Must reside in the hostel of the Department of Technical Education to receive the Rs.60 per month stipend; otherwise eligible for the Rs.100 per month stipend from the Social Welfare Department.
benefits_summary: Students receive a monthly stipend of Rs.60 from the Department of Technical Education and Rs.40 (or Rs.100 if not receiving the former) from the Social Welfare Department.
